title: Uniqueness of normalized diagonal conormal derivations
statement: For every f, two diagonal conormal derivations satisfying IsDiagonalConormalDerivation are equal.

proof.text: Apply PresheafOfModules.Derivation'.ext to reduce equality to D₁.d a = D₂.d a for each open U and section a. Apply diagonalConormal_affine_sections_unique to U.unop, D₁, D₂ and the two unchanged normalization hypotheses. Its statement covers all opens, so no affine covering or existence theorem is used.
